body:
## Why

- The README duplicated `.agent/docs/index.md` almost verbatim — and the docs copy had drifted **newer** than the README (agent-tracked setup-check wording, absolute workflow links), so the README was the stale one.
- docs.sepo.sh now auto-syncs from `.agent/docs` every 15 minutes (self-evolving/docs#14), so the rendered docs site is always current — the README no longer needs to carry the full documentation.

## What

Restructured like lean-workspace-template's README:

- teaser image (the existing overview graphic)
- link row: [Quick start](https://docs.sepo.sh/tutorials/) | [Documentation](https://docs.sepo.sh) | [Website](https://sepo.sh) | [Try Sepo](https://app.sepo.sh)
- one-paragraph pitch + three bullets mirroring the sepo.sh landing framing (work in place / the repo learns / own the long horizon)
- get-started line (template + App install, with in-repo links to the quick start and existing-repo install guides so template-created copies keep working links)
- license section

**Nothing moves and nothing is lost**: every section the old README carried already exists in `.agent/docs` (the source of truth the docs site publishes), so this is a pure deletion of the duplicate plus the new front door. 115 lines → 26.

## Verification

- `.agent` `npm run build` + `npm run check:docs` pass (5/5) — the docs-validation suite only guards `.agent/docs/**`, which is untouched.
- Confirmed no tooling depends on README content (test/skill references to README are fixtures or target-repo guidance).

title: Slim the README to a minimal front door
